data.narrative:
DefSecIntel is a Series A-stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the same sector and stage, including peers such as Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach. Based on three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M—the median valuation is $400M. This method establishes a range of $125M to $4.0B across the peer set, reflecting substantial heterogeneity in the Defense & Security Series A cohort.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. Key uncertainties include the significant dispersion within the peer universe, where the highest-valued comparable exceeds the lowest by a factor of 32x, suggesting that stage and sector alone are insufficient differentiators. The single-method reliance—owing to limited disclosed financial metrics in the private peer set—limits analytical robustness. Refinement would require additional data on revenue, growth rates, or customer concentration to calibrate position within the peer range.
